units.source_text: 他展开这人工翼，轻轻松松地飞上天空。

en.t: He spread these artificial wings and flew lightly up into the sky.

units.source_text: 与此同时，理智的光芒照耀的人生的喜怒哀乐在他的眼底下。

en.t: At the same time, the joys and sorrows of life, illuminated by the light of reason, lay beneath his eyes.

units.source_text: 他鄙视的望向穷街陋巷，穿过一无遮拦的太空，径直飞向太阳。

en.t: He looked down with contempt at the poor streets and alleys, passed through the unobstructed vast sky, and flew straight toward the sun.

units.source_text: 他似乎忘记了古希腊人因人工翼被阳光烤化而终于坠海而死的事……

en.t: He seemed to have forgotten how the ancient Greek man died after his artificial wings were melted by the sunlight and he finally fell into the sea...
